answer: A first-seen claim counts only after it escrows k units of this epoch's per-head payout for k later checkpoints, k being first-seen keys already accepted this window including itself. One honest orchard locks 1 unit for 1 checkpoint; the tenth clone locks 10 for 10, so capital at risk is k squared. The protocol holds the ferrous purse and forfeits a recycle before those checkpoints close, so one purse cannot cover two heads. Nobody resets, splits or pre-ages the protocol's own atlas of checkpoints, and an unpaid lock drops the submit.
